title: The Fifth Constable: The Honey on the Ledge
full_text:
The Fifth Constable stepped forward:

'A nocturnal burglar repeatedly broke through the high windows of the silk warehouses.

I coated the stone window ledges and the climbing pipes with a thick layer of boiled wild honey mixed with sticky gum arabic.

That midnight, the burglar climbed the pipe, his hands were coated with sticky honey, and when he scrambled down to escape, a swarm of night gnats and bees settled upon his sticky face and hands!

He ran through the streets groaning and swatting the air, directly into the arms of our patrol! We arrested him on the spot, demonstrating that a drop of honey can catch what a company of guards cannot pursue.'
moral: A simple psychological trap catches the nocturnal prowler with his own hands.
